title: 体验、休闲与复利型爱好
description: 把纯粹享受、恢复支持、技能复利、社交连接、创造表达和注意力成本放进同一套兴趣组合判断，让值得深化的爱好自然成长，也允许大量兴趣只被享受。
demand: 建立一个不把生活全部项目化的兴趣与体验系统：能区分 casual enjoyment、recovery-supporting leisure、compound hobby 与正式 Skill，选择值得长期投入的音乐、游戏、摄影、运动、烹饪、咖啡、户外、汽车 / 赛车、旅行等方向，同时限制低质量刺激、消费升级和注意力损耗。

units.title: U1 · 休闲、爱好与 Skill 的边界
units.capability: C1 区分 enjoy / explore / park / compound hobby / formal Skill，不把每个兴趣都课程化

units.title: U2 · 内在动机、乐趣与长期粘性
units.capability: C2 判断一个爱好是否真正提供自主、能力增长、关系或纯粹乐趣，而不是主要由身份、消费和外部评价驱动

units.title: U3 · 休闲、恢复与心理脱离
units.capability: C3 让 leisure 支持心理脱离、放松、情绪切换和恢复，但不让 hobby 篡夺 Health 的恢复 owner

units.title: U4 · 复利型爱好与能力成长
units.capability: C4 识别值得多年积累的技能型爱好，用真实 practice、feedback 和作品 / 表现形成复利，而不把乐趣榨成 KPI

units.title: U5 · 社交、创造、身体与体验扩张
units.capability: C5 用爱好连接人、创造表达、身体体验和新环境，并判断不同价值是否真的存在

units.title: U6 · 注意力、消费、刺激与失控边界
units.capability: C6 识别 FOMO、装备升级、刷榜、无尽内容、赌博式机制和功能受损，避免娱乐反过来占领生活

units.title: U7 · Explore、Park、Promote 与 Stop
units.capability: C7 用低成本尝试、真实回访和注意力预算管理兴趣生命周期，只有经现实证明值得长期深化的方向才升级

assets.title: 总框架
assets.label: 先建立一个允许快乐、允许放弃、也允许真正热爱自然复利的兴趣组合

assets.title: U1 · 休闲、爱好与 Skill 的边界
assets.label: 不是每个兴趣都值得变成计划、课程和长期债务

assets.title: U2 · 内在动机、乐趣与长期粘性
assets.label: 先看活动本身是否让你愿意回来，而不是它看起来多酷

assets.title: U3 · 休闲、恢复与心理脱离
assets.label: 休闲可以帮助恢复，但恢复不需要被强迫产出作品或能力

assets.title: U4 · 复利型爱好与能力成长
assets.label: 音乐、摄影、格斗、赛车等只有在真的想长期成长时才进入能力轨道

assets.title: U5 · 社交、创造、身体与体验扩张
assets.label: 好的爱好可以把生活连接到人、作品、身体和更大的世界

assets.title: U6 · 注意力、消费、刺激与失控边界
assets.label: 娱乐的价值必须扣除睡眠、健康、关系、金钱和注意力的真实代价

assets.title: U7 · Explore、Park、Promote 与 Stop
assets.label: 用真实兴趣和真实使用决定是否升级，不让 novelty 自动获得 Skill 地位

capability_map: C1 组合边界：enjoy / explore / park / compound hobby / formal Skill / no curriculum
C2 动机：intrinsic enjoyment / autonomy / competence / relatedness / identity / status
C3 恢复：detachment / relaxation / active leisure / health-owner boundary / no-output legitimacy
C4 复利：practice / feedback / mastery / repertoire / performance / artifact / maintenance
C5 扩张：social / creative / physical / aesthetic / cultural / travel / novelty with meaning
C6 风险：attention / sleep / sedentary time / compulsion / monetization / gear / FOMO / gambling-like loops
C7 生命周期：cheap sample / admission criteria / promote / maintain / park / stop / re-enter

related_skill_candidates.relation: Health owns recovery, physical health and compulsive / harmful-use escalation boundaries; hobbies may support recovery but never need to justify themselves by recovery output
Learning owns capability formation when an interest is deliberately promoted into skill growth; casual enjoyment does not inherit Learning debt
Communication owns relationship skill; hobby groups and shared activities can provide social context without turning relationships into networking assets
Design owns deeper aesthetic / creative judgment; photography, music visuals, curation and craft hobbies may reuse it when genuinely promoted
Decision owns large time / money commitments; this Skill provides hobby-specific value, attention and lifecycle evidence
